result.topic_en: Riemann shows that a function with the stated branching properties satisfies a second-order linear differential equation y''+py'+qy=0 with single-valued coefficients p and q, obtained from two branches y_1, y_2. He argues that p and q are unchanged under the linear substitution of the branches, because numerator and denominator both acquire the factor (ad-bc).

methods.what: Second-order linear ODE satisfied by the function, with single-valued coefficients
Determining p from two branches y_1, y_2 by eliminating between the two ODEs (Wronskian-type quotient)
Invariance of p, q under the linear substitution of branches: numerator and denominator both acquire the determinant factor (ad-bc)
methods.quote:

als Nenner in den Ausdrücken für p und q den Factor $(ad-bc)$,
; die Größen selbst bleiben also ungeändert.

methods.what: A single-valued function is determined up to a constant by its discontinuities (where it becomes infinite)
methods.quote: Um nun eine einwerthige Function bis auf eine Constante zu bestimmen, [-hat man nur-] [-alle Werthe-], wo sie unendlich ist, ihre Unstetigkeiten zu kennen.
